about:
Profile Plastics operates a manufacturing plant in Chanhassen, Minnesota, where it produces custom thermoplastic injection-molded parts. The company was established as a United States plastic parts manufacturer, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

Its core capabilities center on advanced molding techniques that combine decoration and electronics with injection molding. These include In-Mold Decorating (IMD), In-Mold Labeling (IML) also known as Film Insert Molding (FIM), In-Mold Electronics (IME), and Injection Molded Structural Electronics (IMSE), all delivered with precision registered graphics. The firm also provides integrated engineering, development, and molding services under one roof and employs cell manufacturing to reduce costs, accelerate turnaround, and improve quality.

Profile Plastics serves the automotive, medical, and appliance sectors, supplying OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers with decorated and electronically functional plastic components. Examples include driver-interface parts for vehicles, healthcare device housings, and intuitive control panels for appliances.

The company emphasizes a hybrid model: the focus and expertise of a small company paired with the resources and purchasing power of a large corporation. It highlights its IMSE technology as a next-generation method that fuses human-machine interfaces, enabling customers to respond to unanticipated demand and elevate part functionality.
